name: Kutt
description: Kutt is a modern URL shortener that provides a simple and efficient way to manage and track your links. With features like custom aliases, link analytics, and privacy controls, Kutt is ideal for individuals and businesses looking to optimize their link sharing and tracking processes.

events.d: Show all shortened links in your Kutt account.
Shorten a target link and return a short URL. Supports optional custom alias, expiry time, description, and password protection.
Delete a shortened link by its ID.
